description: Land Title Settlement Department - Nallachchiya, Thambutthegama D/S Division, Anuradhapura District and other Title Registrations
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains a declaration by the Commissioner of Title Settlement determining title to specific land parcels (numbered 1602-1710) in various locations, along with a detailed schedule listing parcel numbers, extents, ownership details (Sri Lanka Mahaweli Authority), and title classifications. The content appears in "PART III - LANDS" of the gazette and focuses entirely on land property matters, fitting the definition of Type 4 (Land Gazettes).
